name: Tunnels
description: An underground mine labyrinth, 176 x 176 m, with some 20 m of relief: galleries that climb and drop by inclines and stair drifts, two shafts with ledges and a bridge over the pit, a deep sump, a narrow-gauge haulage line with points, a siding and mine carts, rooms full of mine gear. Steady caged lamps, dark stretches and red emergency lamps. Assault (the Allies push in from the west galleries: generator room, sump, collapse), Team Deathmatch and Solo.
